behavior: Keeps stable graph object identities, aliases and cycles while updating live contents after Python builders. Replacing meta creates a new object; mutating it retains references held by an in-progress visit.

Trusted synchronous Python lazy builders are invoked only when the original traversal requests them. Cached and loose lazy nodes do not execute builders. A shared lazy builder runs once per projector; exceptions retain the original Python object.

The mechanically reviewed async adaptation preserves each original visit in order. It changes only suspension points and sequential container loops; it does not pre-resolve builders, replay previous visits or call validators/transforms/toJSON hooks.
Each operation consumes the mounted jsRuntime service and releases its worker in finally. Awaiter cancellation shields the owned terminal future, disposes the process and leaves no active worker.
